description: InfoWorks WS Pro is Autodesk's commercial software for modelling water distribution networks, inherited from the former Innovyze product line. The product page read on 2026-09-28 presents it as one platform for hydraulic simulation, emergency response and master planning, with water hammer and transient analysis to prevent pipe bursts, real-time modelling, criticality assessment that ranks the consequence of asset failures, running multiple models under failure or demand scenarios, cloud collaboration and integration with Autodesk's Info360 asset tools; customer quotes from Hunter Water in Australia and Bristol Water in England describe its use for failure consequence analysis and incident response. Coverage is not geographic: utilities worldwide use it for their own networks. Access is paid; licence terms and prices are not on the page. Caveats: it is proprietary, so models built in it are hard to share openly, and the page is marketing material without technical specifications. It supports network flow and resilience studies, such as simulating a trunk main failure to find which customers lose pressure and how valves and storage can restore supply. Related records: Autodesk InfoDrainage and XPSWMM for drainage modelling.
